answer: Active agents must lock a 40-token copper stake and clear an 8-gigabyte metered traffic quota every 6 hours through countersigned peer receipts. If an attacker registers 100 fake IDs, it must lock 4,000 tokens and serve 800 gigabytes of live responses, and any account caught forging an echo receipt forfeits 100% of its escrow during random audit checks. One honest agent fulfills its 8-gigabyte delta of routine service traffic once and recovers its entire stake. This fails if a majority of sampled auditors collude to sign false bandwidth logs for idle accounts.
